implemented_source: One-use native capability captures the exact Core object after its immutable save/master/content identity matches. No caller supplies an initial scope.
Host records that capability before install and may create its internal auth routes while the actual scope is pending. Tokens cannot issue before same-Core services bind.
Host schedules existing Core preparation on a native IO queue, without waiting/spinning on main. Core still refuses main/any Core owner queue and uses its one existing owner connection.
A normal main callback adopts only the actual returned local-player/content/save-scope receipt from that same capability. No player values, clocks, stats or rewards are invented.
The caller can then construct its actual services/projector on IO with the real scope; Host binding requires services own Core object equal the captured capability Core, not just matching strings.
All bounded pending auth remains blocked until this admission AND actual services bind. Existing pre/post canonical snapshots still enforce current scope at every auth response.
Preparation failure uses fixed errors and drains pending requests as failures. Original UI is never replaced by a new preparation screen.
Only immutable admission metadata is retained by the capability; the canonical player snapshot is validated then discarded.
limits: This wires actual native Host admission hooks, not a selected production factory. The diagnostic constructor does not invoke them.
A valid native IO preparation queue and actual same-Core services/projector still have to be supplied by the real integrated composition.
Native master acceptance, real login/home/battle/save/custom-unit runtime and physical Duo verification remain independent.
The current build authorization is owned by the integration lead; no parallel build/check was initiated for this source cohort.
